Hibernian Hall (Boston, Massachusetts) | The Hibernian Hall is a historic building at 182-186 Dudley Street in the Roxbury neighborhood of Boston, Massachusetts. Hibernian have won the Scottish Cup three times, the last time in 2016.  This win ended a drought of 114 years and ten cup finals lost since 1902.  The club has won the League Cup three times, most recently when they defeated Kilmarnock 5–1 in 2007.

Wonder Ballroom | The Wonder Ballroom is a music venue located in northeast Portland, Oregon.  Prior to opening in 2004, the building (originally constructed in 1914) was occupied by the Ancient Order of Hibernians, the Catholic Youth Organization, the Portland Boxing School, the American Legion Organization, and a community center eventually known as the Collins Center.
